desc:
🖥️ Welcome to Steal A PC!

How to Play:
📦 Steal boxes from the zone guardians
🏃 Outrun them back to the Safe Zone
🔓 Unbox your loot to collect rare PCs
💰 Earn money from the PCs in your pen
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and pen
👟 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🗺️ Unlock 30 zones, each with brand-new PCs
✨ Discover Secret & Divine Pcs, and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
